facts: Deed from Denise Kroll to her daughter Amanda Kroll for $1. The parcel is classified commercial real property under section 34c — a four-unit strip retail building. Amanda continues operating it as retail rental space. The deed was recorded in March 2026.

expected.notes: TRAP — 27a(7)(u) applies to RESIDENTIAL real property. A commercial-classified parcel is outside the exception regardless of the family relationship. Expected uncapping. [FACTS TIGHTENED 2026-08-04, systematic audit: the statute defines 'residential real property' as property CLASSIFIED as such under section 34c, and the family/trust exceptions in (7)(u), (7)(g)(ii) and (7)(v) all begin 'Beginning December 31, 2014'. Cases that said only 'residential parcel' with no date left the model unable to tell (7)(t) from (7)(u) — which is what made TD-FAMRES-003 fail before it was fixed the same way. Classification and a transfer date are now stated wherever they are load-bearing. The legal question each case tests is unchanged.]
